# G502 X PLUS through the LIGHTSPEED receiver (USB 046D:C547, device index 1),
# captured 2026-11-20 with hidapi 2.6.7 by a throwaway program. Requests sent
# with software ID 0x0D, the one G HUB uses: these are real responses meant for
# another program, which palaswitch must never take for its own.
# onboard profiles getCurrentProfile, software ID 0x0D
TX 11 01 0B 4D 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RX 11 01 0B 4D 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
# onboard profiles getInfo, software ID 0x0D
TX 11 01 0B 0D 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RX 11 01 0B 0D 01 05 01 05 02 0B 10 00 FF 0A 04 00 00 00 00 00
